metrics.accounts: EX = the scene's most frequent training binding for the role (excl. correct); IS = the most similar training instruction's binding (word Jaccard), mapped by name / type key
metrics.baseline: PRIMARY frequency-matched: candidates weighted 1 + global training count of the type key; uniform descriptive
metrics.falsified_if: two-level task bootstrap 95% CI of mean(hit_EX - P_freq) has lo <= 0
metrics.units: zs binding failures on the dev tasks (fm types, fresh_m1): wrong_object (bound object), wrong_goal other_region (BDDL alt), carried_elsewhere (nearest scene site within 10 cm); dry run: 135 units (63 object, 72 goal), 80 excluded, 43 EX-undefined
